_measurement_context.result_convention: headline min/max are the range of the three process medians; all-sample min/max are retained separately
_measurement_context.timing_runs: 3 independent processes per condition; at least 1 untimed warmup and 7 timed samples in each process; JIT-on timing also warms once after compilation

fireball_a1.build: native interpreter, normal build, assert enabled

jit_diagnostics.build: QA-only interpreter/JIT diagnostics, release NDEBUG; excluded from timing

jit_time.build: Tier 3 x64 JIT release build, NDEBUG

wamr.build: Fast Interpreter; AOT, LLVM JIT, and Fast JIT disabled

timing_method.fireball: perf_counter_ns around NativeInterpreter.call(...).unwrap(); parsing and native build are outside the timer.
timing_method.jit: Release build; JIT-off and JIT-on each use three independent processes per condition. JIT compilation is warmed outside timing; each process has a post-compile steady-state warmup before seven timed calls.
timing_method.statistics: Headline is median of three process medians; process median min/max and complete timed sample min/max are retained.
timing_method.wamr: perf_counter_ns around wasm_runtime_call_wasm only; runtime init, module load, instantiate, function lookup, and result validation are outside the timer.
timing_method.warmup: One untimed warmup per function before seven timed samples in each process.

workload.normalized_disassembly: The function instruction sequences are identical; the binary hashes differ because the Wasmtime binary includes a name custom section omitted by WABT.
